1) 从告警标签取 cp_code，在 Akamai Control Cente: 1) Take cp_code from the alert labels and drill down by response code in Traffic Reports in the Akamai Control Center to see whether the errors concentrate on one 5xx code or are spread out; 2) Concentrated 504/502 point to the origin: check origin health and the origin fetch path by curl-ing the origin directly; 3) Concentrated 500 suggests a recent Property configuration release (redirect rules, EdgeWorkers scripts); roll back to the previous version if needed; 4) Compare against the origin 5xx metric to decide whether the fault is at the edge or the origin; edge-side problems need a ticket to Akamai.
1) 从告警标签取 cp_code，在 Control Center 的 Off: 1) Take cp_code from the alert labels and use the Offload report in Control Center to see which URLs the origin fetches concentrate on; 2) The most common cause is the origin returning Cache-Control: no-store/private or no cache headers at all; check the origin response headers; 3) If random query parameters are fragmenting the cache, configure the Property to ignore irrelevant query parameters (cache key normalisation); 4) Once the cache rules are correct, watch offload recover; if it stays low, check whether the content is inherently uncacheable (heavily personalised dynamic requests).
1) 从告警标签取 cp_code，在 Traffic Reports 里按 U: 1) Take cp_code from the alert labels and drill down by URL in Traffic Reports to see which paths the 4xx concentrate on; 2) Concentration on a few paths usually means resources were retired or moved; confirm with the business owner and configure redirects; 3) Concentrated 403 means hotlink protection, token authentication, or geo-blocking rules were just changed; 4) Random paths at high volume indicate scanning; configure rate limiting rules in the Akamai WAF.
1) 从告警标签取 cp_code，直接对源站地址执行 curl -sI 复现，: 1) Take cp_code from the alert labels and reproduce with curl -sI against the origin address to confirm the origin really is erroring; 2) Check the origin application logs and load; a surge of origin traffic overwhelming the origin is a common scenario; 3) If the origin is healthy but fetches still fail, check the origin Host header and whether the origin's IP allowlist is missing Akamai's origin fetch ranges; 4) As an emergency measure raise the cache TTL or enable Akamai's Site Failover to preserve availability for users.
回源请求中 5xx 占比超过 1%，源站正在大量报错。缓存能挡住一部分影响，但缓: More than 1% of origin fetches returned 5xx, so the origin is erroring heavily. Caching absorbs some of the impact, but users will be affected once the cache expires.
回源请求响应状态码数: Origin Requests by Response Status Code
总的回源请求响应状态码占比: Total Origin Response Status Code Ratio
请求卸载率（边缘直接命中、无需回源的比例）低于 80%，回源流量偏高，源站压力与: The request offload ratio (the share served straight from the edge without an origin fetch) has fallen below 80%. Origin traffic is elevated, raising both origin load and bandwidth cost.
边缘节点返回 4xx 的请求占比超过 10%，可能是资源被删、鉴权配置变更，也可: More than 10% of requests served by edge nodes returned 4xx. This may mean resources were deleted or authentication configuration changed, or it may be malicious scanning generating large numbers of 404s.
边缘节点返回 5xx 的请求占比超过 1%，说明相当比例的用户请求已经失败，通常: More than 1% of requests served by edge nodes returned 5xx, so a meaningful share of user requests is already failing. This is usually caused by failed origin fetches or an edge configuration error.
